daas-irab:26-28.t: ﴿وَيَسْتَجِيبُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb; ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا; ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وَيَزِيدُهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿وَالْكافِرُونَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿شَدِيدٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the nominal clause is the khabar of الكافرون, and the clause of الكافرون is resumptive; ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لو is a conditional particle that does not make the verb jussive; ﴿بَسَطَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); ﴿لِعِبادِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿لَبَغَوْا﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached to the verb, and the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk); ﴿يُنَزِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿بِقَدَرٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila of ما; ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾ both attached to خبير; ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾ first khabar; ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾ second khabar, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ; ﴿الَّذِي﴾ khabar; ﴿يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila of الذي, and the clause of هو is resumptive; ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun); ﴿قَنَطُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from ما and the verb is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿وَيَنْشُرُ﴾ conjoined to ينزل; ﴿رَحْمَتَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ and two khabars, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:29-33.t: ﴿وَمِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a preposition; ﴿مِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ a noun in the genitive (majrūr) by من, and both are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿خَلْقُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات; ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is a relative, conjoined to خلق; ﴿بَثَّ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿فِيهِما﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿مِنْ دابَّةٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ; ﴿عَلى جَمْعِهِمْ﴾ both attached to قدير; ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ khabar, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl; ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and ما is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, a mubtadaʾ; ﴿أَصابَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿فَبِما﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and بما are both attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "فهو بسبب الذي" (so it is because of that which); ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ a past verb; ﴿أَيْدِيكُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila, and the nominal clause "هو بسبب" is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; ﴿وَيَعْفُوا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿عَنْ كَثِيرٍ﴾ both attached to the verb, and the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "والله يعفو" (and Allah pardons), and the nominal clause is a ḥāl; ﴿وَما﴾ a conjunction, and ما is negative, operating like ليس; ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ its noun; ﴿بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and genitive in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, the khabar of ما; ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached to معجزين, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative; ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar; ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition; ﴿وَلِيٍّ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ; ﴿وَلا نَصِيرٍ﴾ conjoined to من ولي, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَمِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and من is a preposition; ﴿آياتِهِ﴾ a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar; ﴿الْجَوارِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ that was dropped for lightening; ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl; ﴿كَالْأَعْلامِ﴾ a second ḥāl, and the nominal clause من آياته is resumptive; ﴿إِنْ يَشَأْ﴾ إن is conditional, and an imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); ﴿يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the apodosis, the fāʿil is latent, and الريح is its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. «[Translator's note: so in the source, although إن here is a jussive conditional particle.]» ﴿فَيَظْلَلْنَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb and its noun; ﴿رَواكِدَ﴾ its khabar; ﴿عَلى ظَهْرِهِ﴾ both attached to رواكد, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb «[Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is إِنَّ.]»; ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ both attached to the omitted fronted khabar of إن; ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is its postponed noun; ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of آيات; ﴿صَبَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿شَكُورٍ﴾ an adjective of صبار, and the nominal clause إن في ذلك is resumptive.

daas-irab:34-37.t: ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿يُوبِقْهُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿بِما﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; ﴿وَيَعْفُ﴾ conjoined to يسكن, so it is jussive (majzūm) like it, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿عَنْ كَثِيرٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿وَيَعْلَمَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the wāw, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil; ﴿يُجادِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿فِي آياتِنا﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ negative; ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿مَحِيصٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and ما is a conditional noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أُوتِيتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما; ﴿فَمَتاعُ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and متاع is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ما أوتيتم is resumptive; ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ما is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is a ḥāl; ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾ conjoined to خير; ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to أبقى; ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿وَعَلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتوكلون; ﴿يَتَوَكَّلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position; ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is conjoined to للذين; ﴿يَجْتَنِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿كَبائِرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الْإِثْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وَالْفَواحِشَ﴾ conjoined to كبائر; ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverbial conditional that does not make the verb jussive; ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida); ﴿غَضِبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿يَغْفِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

daas-irab:38-41.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, الذين is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿اسْتَجابُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿لِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿وَأَقامُوا﴾ conjoined to استجابوا; ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وَأَمْرُهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أمرهم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿شُورى﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to شورى; ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾ both attached to ينفقون; ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to the ṣila clause; ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverbial conditional that does not make the verb jussive; ﴿أَصابَهُمُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الْبَغْيُ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿يَنْتَصِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position; ﴿وَجَزاءُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ; ﴿سَيِّئَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿سَيِّئَةٍ﴾ khabar «[Translator's note: so vocalised in the source; in the verse the second word is سَيِّئَةٌ, nominative.]»; ﴿مِثْلُها﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of سيئة, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and of consequence (tafrīʿ), and a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, a mubtadaʾ; ﴿عَفا﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿وَأَصْلَحَ﴾ conjoined to عفا; ﴿فَأَجْرُهُ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis, and a mubtadaʾ; ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by على, and both are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of من; ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿لا﴾ negative; ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; ﴿وَلَمَنِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and من is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, a mubtadaʾ; ﴿انْتَصَرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿ظُلْمِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿ما﴾ negative; ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a fronted khabar; ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿سَبِيلٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause of أولئك is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of من.

daas-irab:42-45.t: ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa); ﴿السَّبِيلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are its khabar (predicate); ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وَيَبْغُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar; ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause of أولئك is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿وَلَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is of inception (ibtidāʾ), and من is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿صَبَرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿وَغَفَرَ﴾ conjoined to صبر; ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿لَمَنْ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and من is a preposition; ﴿عَزْمِ﴾ a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of inna; ﴿الْأُمُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause إن ذلك is the khabar of من; ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, a mubtadaʾ; ﴿يُضْلِلِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil; ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and ما is negative; ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar; ﴿مِنْ وَلِيٍّ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and ولي is genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective of ولي, and the clause ماله من ولي is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the clause من يضلل is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the two clauses of the condition and its apodosis are the khabar of من; ﴿وَتَرَى﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لَمَّا﴾ adverbial, of time (ḥīniyya); ﴿رَأَوُا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl; ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle; ﴿إِلى مَرَدٍّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar; ﴿مَنْ﴾ a redundant preposition «[Translator's note: so vocalised in the source; the verse has مِنْ.]»; ﴿سَبِيلٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿وَتَراهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿يُعْرَضُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is circumstantial, and the clause تراهم is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ both attached to يعرضون; ﴿خاشِعِينَ﴾ ḥāl; ﴿مِنَ الذُّلِّ﴾ both attached to خاشعين; ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; ﴿مِنْ طَرْفٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿خَفِيٍّ﴾ an adjective of طرف, and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb; ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿إِنَّ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾ inna and its noun, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying; ﴿خَسِرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of الذين; ﴿وَأَهْلِيهِمْ﴾ conjoined to أنفسهم; ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh); ﴿إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿فِي عَذابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of inna; ﴿مُقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective of عذاب.

daas-irab:46-48.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and ما is negative; ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, the noun of kāna, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿يَنْصُرُونَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb, and the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of أولياء; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of يضلل; ﴿يُضْلِلِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and ما is negative; ﴿لَهُ﴾ a fronted khabar; ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition; ﴿سَبِيلٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause فما له is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause يضلل is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿اسْتَجِيبُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; ﴿لِرَبِّكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by أن; ﴿يَوْمٌ﴾ fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation; ﴿مَرَدَّ﴾ its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa; ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar of lā, and the nominal clause لا مرد له is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of يوم; ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to مرد, and the clause استجيبوا is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); ﴿ما﴾ negative; ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar; ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition; ﴿مَلْجَإٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿وَما لَكُمْ مِنْ نَكِيرٍ﴾ conjoined to ما لكم من ملجأ, and their i'rab is the same, and the clause ما لكم من ملجأ is resumptive; ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and إن is conditional; ﴿أَعْرَضُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and ما is negative; ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿حَفِيظاً﴾ its second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause أعرضوا is initial, and the clause أرسلناك is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative; ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a fronted khabar; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿الْبَلاغُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position; ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ a resumptive particle, and inna and its noun; ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverbial conditional that does not make the verb jussive; ﴿أَذَقْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿الْإِنْسانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation; ﴿مِنَّا﴾ both attached to رحمة; ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فَرِحَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿بِها﴾ both attached to the verb, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, and the conditional clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the clause إنا is resumptive; ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, the protasis, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿سَيِّئَةٌ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is initial, with no grammatical position; ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; ﴿فَإِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ كَفُورٌ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, and inna, its noun and its khabar, and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:49-51.t: ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿يَخْلُقُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; ﴿يَهَبُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is a badal (substitute) for يخلق; ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿إِناثاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of من; ﴿وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ الذُّكُورَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the i'rab is the same; ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿يُزَوِّجُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿ذُكْراناً﴾ ḥāl; ﴿وَإِناثاً﴾ conjoined to ذكرانا, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَيَجْعَلُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿مَنْ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿عَقِيماً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of من; ﴿إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its first khabar; ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ its second khabar, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and ما is negative; ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿لِبَشَرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its fronted khabar; ﴿أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from أن and the verb is the postponed noun of kāna; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿وَحْياً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿مِنْ وَراءِ﴾ both attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being يسمع (he hears), and it is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿حِجابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿يُرْسِلَ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to يكلمه, accusative, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿رَسُولًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the implied أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined to وحيا, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿فَيُوحِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila; ﴿إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:52-53.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive; ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿رُوحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِنا﴾ an adjective of روحا; ﴿ما﴾ negative; ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿تَدْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the clause ما كنت is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ما﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الْكِتابُ﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause stands in place of the two objects of تدري; ﴿وَلَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negative; ﴿الْإِيمانُ﴾ conjoined to الكتاب; ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk); ﴿جَعَلْناهُ نُوراً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and نورا is its second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to the clause ما كنت; ﴿نَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb, and the clause is an adjective of نورا; ﴿مِنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنا﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿وَإِنَّكَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun; ﴿لَتَهْدِي﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective of صراط, and the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl; ﴿صِراطِ﴾ a badal (substitute) for what precedes it; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿الَّذِي﴾ an adjective of الله; ﴿لَهُ﴾ a fronted khabar; ﴿ما﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the ṣila; ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ both attached to an omitted verb forming the ṣila of the relative; ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh); ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb after them; ﴿تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:1-6.t: ﴿حم عسق﴾ these are letters that have no i'rab. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted element, a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. «مثل ذلك الإيحاء أوحينا» (with the like of that revelation We revealed). ﴿يُوحِي﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to إليك. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the ṣila (relative clause); the verbal clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ two badals (substitutes) from the Name of Majesty. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the ṣila; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾ two khabars of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَكادُ السَّماواتُ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb and its noun (ism). ﴿يَتَفَطَّرْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of تكاد, and the clause تكاد is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُسَبِّحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿بِحَمْدِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the ṣila of من. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ two khabars; the inna clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a mubtadaʾ, and its khabar. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to حفيظ; the nominal clause is the khabar. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ما operates like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to وكيل. ﴿بِوَكِيلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of ما; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:7-10.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the kāf, meaning "like" (mithl), is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi; or the kāf is a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted element, a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُرْآناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَرَبِيًّا﴾ naʿt. ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl). ﴿أُمَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ conjoined to أم. ﴿حَوْلَها﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and what follows it is in the position of genitive by the lām. ﴿وَتُنْذِرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to لتنذر. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi; the first is omitted, its implied form being "تنذر الناس يوم الجمع" (you warn the people of the Day of Gathering). ﴿الْجَمْعِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿رَيْبَ﴾ its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي الْجَنَّةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ﴾ conjoined to فريق في الجنة. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and لو is conditional, not making the verb jussive. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَجَعَلَهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾ its second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ naʿt; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿يُدْخِلُ مَنْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and من is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَالظَّالِمُونَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and الظالمون is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ وَلِيٍّ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and ولي is genitive in form and nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause الظالمون is resumptive. ﴿وَلا نَصِيرٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَمِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَاللَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْوَلِيُّ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُحْيِ الْمَوْتى﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ both attached to قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and ما is a conditional noun making the verb jussive (majzūm), mubtadaʾ. ﴿اخْتَلَفْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl. ﴿فَحُكْمُهُ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the two clauses of condition and apodosis are the khabar of ما, and the clause ما اختلفتم is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, badal (substitute) [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra; in the verse it is nominative, اللَّهُ]. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ khabar. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to توكلت. ﴿تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنيب. ﴿أُنِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:11-13.t: ﴿فاطِرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعل. ﴿وَمِنَ الْأَنْعامِ أَزْواجاً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَذْرَؤُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is a ḥāl from the latent fāʿil of جعل. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿كَمِثْلِهِ﴾ «[Note: If you wish to go further, see what Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh Drāz wrote in his book al-Nabaʾ al-ʿAẓīm, p. 132, on the i'rab of the kāf in this verse.]» the kāf is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and مثله is genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of laysa. ﴿شَيْءٌ﴾ its noun (ism); the clause يذرؤكم is a second khabar of فاطر. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ﴾ two khabars; the nominal clause is circumstantial. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿مَقالِيدُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات; the clause is another khabar of فاطر. ﴿يَبْسُطُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾ its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is another khabar of فاطر. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ conjoined to يشاء. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ both attached to عليم. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿شَرَعَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ الدِّينِ﴾ both also attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَصَّى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿نُوحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is conjoined to ما. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما وَصَّيْنا بِهِ إِبْراهِيمَ وَمُوسى وَعِيسى﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿أَقِيمُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الدِّينِ﴾ its mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra; in the verse it is accusative, الدِّينَ]; the clause is explicative and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَتَفَرَّقُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿كَبُرَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَدْعُوهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَجْتَبِي﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: the source prints the word as مِنَ; the Quranic word is the relative مَنْ; likewise below]. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَهْدِي﴾ conjoined to يجتبي. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُنِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:14-15.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and ما is negative. ﴿تَفَرَّقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿جاءَهُمُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْعِلْمُ﴾ its fāʿil; ما and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَغْياً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and لولا is a conditional particle not making the verb jussive. ﴿كَلِمَةٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is obligatorily omitted. ﴿سَبَقَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of كلمة. ﴿مِنْ﴾ ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ naʿt; the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَقُضِيَ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its noun (ism). ﴿أُورِثُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl. ﴿لَفِي﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿في شَكٍّ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, the khabar of inna; the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ both attached to شك. ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ a naʿt of شك. ﴿فَلِذلِكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ادع. ﴿فَادْعُ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاسْتَقِمْ﴾ conjoined to ادع. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a particle of comparison and of the genitive, and ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿أُمِرْتَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil; ما and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the kāf. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive, making the verb jussive (majzūm). ﴿تَتَّبِعْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿آمَنْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ كِتابٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لِأَعْدِلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿بَيْنَكُمُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ رَبُّنا﴾ the Name of Majesty, a mubtadaʾ, and its khabar. ﴿وَرَبُّكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿أَعْمالُنا﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَكُمْ أَعْمالُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لا حُجَّةَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation, and its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمُ﴾ conjoined to بيننا; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَجْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾ an adverb attached to the verb. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:16-19.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُحَاجُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿اسْتُجِيبَ﴾ a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the verb; ما and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) to which the adverb is annexed. ﴿حُجَّتُهُمْ داحِضَةٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين, and the clause الذين is resumptive. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to داحضة. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿غَضَبٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿شَدِيدٌ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي﴾ the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, and the relative noun is its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلَ الْكِتابَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَالْمِيزانَ﴾ conjoined to الكتاب. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and ما is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُدْرِيكَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of ما. ﴿لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ﴾ laʿalla, its noun (ism) and its khabar; the clause stands in place of the second object of يدريك. ﴿يَسْتَعْجِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿بِهَا﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهَا﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and الذين is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مُشْفِقُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative by the wāw; the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنْها﴾ both attached to مشفقون. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar; anna and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of يعلمون. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يُمارُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي السَّاعَةِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿لَفِي﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿في ضَلالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of inna. ﴿بَعِيدٍ﴾ a naʿt of ضلال; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a mubtadaʾ, and its khabar. ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾ both attached to لطيف. ﴿يَرْزُقُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ and two khabars; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:20-22.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ a conditional noun making the verb jussive (majzūm), mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿حَرْثَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَزِدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فِي حَرْثِهِ﴾ both also attached to the verb; the two clauses of condition and apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَمَنْ كانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْها﴾ the passage is conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ما is negative. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition [Translator's note: the source prints the word as مَنْ; in the verse it is the preposition مِنْ]. ﴿نَصِيبٍ﴾ genitive in form and nominative in position, a mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction meaning "rather" (bal). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿شُرَكاءُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿شَرَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of شركاء. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ الدِّينِ﴾ both also attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَمْ يَأْذَنْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by لم; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to يأذن. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and لولا is a conditional particle not making the verb jussive. ﴿كَلِمَةُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْفَصْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَقُضِيَ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis, and a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of inna, and the inna clause is resumptive and has no [grammatical] position. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ a naʿt of عذاب. ﴿تَرَى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُشْفِقِينَ﴾ a ḥāl, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ both attached to مشفقين; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿واقِعٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ both attached to واقع; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي رَوْضاتِ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْجَنَّاتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar, and ﴿ما﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَشاؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, and the clause لهم ما is resumptive. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْفَضْلُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْكَبِيرُ﴾ a naʿt of الفضل; the nominal clause ذلك هو الفضل is resumptive.

daas-irab:23-25.t: ﴿ذلِكَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿يُبَشِّرُ اللَّهُ عِبادَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عباد. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of الذين. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause قل is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الْمَوَدَّةَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā). ﴿فِي الْقُرْبى﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; من is a conditional noun making the verb jussive (majzūm), mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَقْتَرِفْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil is latent. ﴿حَسَنَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَزِدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿حُسْناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the two clauses of condition and apodosis are the khabar of من, and the clause من is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and the Name of Majesty, its noun (ism). ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ ﴿شَكُورٌ﴾ two khabars; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction meaning "rather" (bal). ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿افْتَرى﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿كَذِباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إن is conditional. ﴿يَشَإِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis; the clause يشأ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَخْتِمْ﴾ is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى قَلْبِكَ﴾ both attached to يختم. ﴿وَيَمْحُ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb and the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿الْباطِلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ﴾ conjoined to يمحو الباطل. ﴿بِكَلِماتِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾ both attached to عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause gives the reason. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقْبَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿التَّوْبَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَيَعْفُوا﴾ conjoined to يقبل. ﴿عَنِ السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تَفْعَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila.
